notes: Fixes the USB-bridge SMART reading that regressed in 0.70.51 (a PowerShell array-handling quirk meant the NVMe health log was read but then lost, so a drive in a caddy fell back to 'Can't read' instead of showing its real health). NVMe-in-a-USB-enclosure drives again report their true health — e.g. the Kioxia reads 48% via the Realtek bridge — plus the real model/serial/firmware from Identify. Also adds a 'Send to Syncro' button on each individual drive card, so you can send one drive's health to a customer's ticket without sending every drive in your own machine (the all-drives button on the tab stays).
